messages:
mira: Heads-up: canary to v2.9.4 started at 02:10 UTC, noticed p95 drift on /v1/embeds at ~02:13.
dan: saw deploybot alert: `deploybot: rollout v2.9.4 canary=8% region=eu-west1`. Any auto-revert?
deploybot: (auto-signal) p95 > threshold for 3m. Autorevert policy=warn-only for this window.
ade: prefer manual hold. We have dedicated tenant pools; flipping could trigger noisy retries.
mira: agree. Plan: soft unshift canary 8%->0% over 3m for dedicated only, pin v2.9.3 for dedicated, open rollback PR, collect traces 20m.
ops-lee: command ready: `rictl traffic shift --service embeds --from v2.9.4 --to v2.9.3 --percent 8 --scope dedicated --duration 180s`
sophie: I'll draft a short customer blurb in case we pin. Keep it factual.
dan: running quick aggregation: increased `kv_cache_miss` and retry spikes correlated with drift.
ops-lee: executing shift now -> response: ok shifting 8->0 over 180s (dedicated).
deploybot: canary now at 5%.
mira: monitoring metrics.
(90s)
dan: p95 trending down at 4% canary but still slightly elevated; CPU on dedicated nodes normalizing.
a de: start pin: `rictl pin version --service embeds --version v2.9.3 --scope dedicated --note "post-canary soft unshift 02:16 UTC"` -> ok.
sophie: customer blurb ready: "We observed short-lived latency increase on embeddings; traffic shifted back to stable version for dedicated pools. No data impact"
mira: create rollback PR to formally revert infra canary manifests.
ops-lee: PR created: https://git.internal/infra/pull/4981 (revert v2.9.4 canary for dedicated).
deploybot: canary for dedicated drained to 0%; rollout halted.
dan: starting 20m trace collection; will post early notes in ~10m.
mira: decision: manual soft rewind executed, dedicated pinned to v2.9.3 for 12h pending RCA. Owners: dan=trace, ops-lee=pin+PR, sophie=customer comms, ade=monitor.
ops-lee: adding change-window note and scheduling patch slot.
sophie: will send customer note after verification window.
mira: thanks all. :thumbsup:
(20m later)
dan: preliminary RCA: kernel path fallback on quantized kernels increases per-token CPU on long contexts; draft PM to follow.
mira: include remediation options (kernel guard flag, canary gating).
ops-lee: merging revert PR now.
deploybot: PR merged; canary manifests restored to v2.9.3 for dedicated.
mira: closing thread for immediate ops. Follow-ups in postmortem.
